claims.claim_ar: التفاتٍ بلاغي من صيغة تقرير الغائب (قَالُوا) إلى توكيد المتكلم (إِنَّا) في الجملة اللاحقة، أي انتقال في الأشخاص والأسلوب لزيادة الحضور والخبرة في النفي/الإنكار.
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical shift (iltifat) from the reporting form (قَالُوا) to the speaker's emphatic self-reference (إِنَّا) in the following clause — a change of person/style that increases immediacy and asserts the speakers' stance in denying responsibility.
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates immediacy and a stronger denial by switching from a report of speech to an emphatic first‑person assertion

claims.claim_ar: استعمال إنّ + ضمير (إِنَّا) لتوكيد المعنى والإصرار على بيان الحالة والنتيجة (إنا إذًا لخاسرون)، أي إنّ إنّ هنا تعمل وظيفة التأكيد والبيان القاطع.
claims.claim_en: Use of the particle إِنَّ with the pronoun (إِنَّا) to emphasize and assert the proposition and its consequence ("indeed we would be losers"). إِنَّ here functions as a forceful emphatic/augmentative particle.
claims.needs_review_reason: mapping the traditional grammatical role of إنّ to the K‑Map subtype 'ijab_inshaa' (emphatic/illative function) should be cross‑checked with other rhetorical sources.
claims.rhetorical_effect: gives strong certitude to the consequence clause, intensifying the admission of loss if the asserted event occurred

claims.source_quote_ar: (أكل) فعل ماض و (الهاء) ضمير مفعول به (الذئب) فاعل مرفوع
claims.claim_ar: تظهير سبب خارجي (الذئب) كوكيل على الفعل ليكون عذراً يبرئهم من التهمة؛ صيغة تُوظَّف بلاغياً ككنية عن المسؤولية المباشرة.
claims.claim_en: Presenting an external agent (the wolf) as the doer of the act functions as an indirect attribution/excuse (kinayah), rhetorically shifting blame away from the speakers themselves.
claims.needs_review_reason: interpretation as kinayah (an excuse) is plausible in exegetical tradition but could be debated; consult additional tafsir notes for corroboration.
claims.rhetorical_effect: deflects blame and solicits sympathy or acquittal by attributing the act to a wild animal rather than to human agency
